description: Read the router-served local self-deployment process identity, immutable release identity, deterministic source and release surface digests, and already-loaded module origins. This verb is read-only and never imports a requested module.
embedding_description: Verify which immutable macOS blue-green release is serving and whether its already-loaded Python modules came from that release. Use for reconciliation verification or doctor diagnostics of shipped-but-unread code.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Router and process identity, immutable release digests, and requested module load origins.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with served_by_self, release_id, current_release_id, and the two surface digests. Call out any unloaded module or module origin outside the immutable release root.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A failed attestation means the serving process, its immutable release metadata, or router state could not be measured safely; it is not evidence that the requested code is serving.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Do not treat an unreadable attestation as a mismatch. Inspect the named release and router state, then retry the read-only verb after the cause is resolved.
